params.name: state
params.doc: Initial door state: 'open', 'closed' or 'locked'.

params.name: key
params.doc: Item prototype label required to lock or unlock the door.

params.name: tags
params.doc: Tags the rules read, such as 'heavy', 'creaky' or 'transparent', to price sensing and muffling.

params.name: direction
params.doc: Exit direction name, such as 'north', 'up' or a custom word.

params.name: to
params.doc: Destination room label.

params.name: entry_index
params.doc: Track index in the destination room where travellers arrive, or -1 for the back.

params.name: tags
params.doc: Tags the rules read, such as 'soundproof' or 'sealed', to price sensing across the exit.

params.name: door
params.doc: Optional door on this exit, built with door(...).

params.name: one_way
params.doc: True if this exit intentionally has no return exit.

params.name: id
params.doc: The item's declaration name within the package.

params.name: name
params.doc: Display name shown to players.

params.name: plural
params.doc: Display name for stacks of 2 or more, such as 'gold coins'.

params.name: keywords
params.doc: Words players can use to target this item.

params.name: desc
params.doc: Description shown when examining the item.

params.name: kind
params.doc: Item category, such as 'misc', 'melee', 'ranged', 'armor' or 'key'.

params.name: range
params.doc: Weapon reach band: 'melee', 'near' or 'far'.

params.name: weight
params.doc: Weight of one item.

params.name: value
params.doc: Base price of one item; 0 by default.

params.name: wear
params.doc: Equipment slot or slot family the item is worn in.

params.name: wield
params.doc: Alias for wear, for weapons.

params.name: slot_cost
params.doc: How many slots of its family the item takes up; at least 1.

params.name: dice
params.doc: Weapon damage dice such as '1d6+1'.

params.name: damage_type
params.doc: Weapon damage type, a declared damage type such as DAMAGE.slash.

params.name: stat_deltas
params.doc: Stat adjustments applied while the item is worn, built with stats(...).

params.name: sense_deltas
params.doc: Sense score changes by channel while the item is worn.

params.name: max_vital_deltas
params.doc: Vital maximum adjustments applied while the item is worn, built with vitals(...).

params.name: resist_deltas
params.doc: Damage resistance adjustments applied while the item is worn, built with resists(...).

params.name: tags
params.doc: Tags for plugin restrictions and scripts.

params.name: stackable
params.doc: True if identical items merge into a stack.

params.name: decay_pulses
params.doc: Pulses before the item decays, or None for permanent items.

params.name: container
params.doc: Container settings, built with container(...).

params.name: commands
params.doc: Item-local commands mapping verb name to fn(ctx).

params.name: hooks
params.doc: Custom hooks, by name, run with ctx.call_hook.

params.name: equip_affects
params.doc: Affects applied when the item is worn: a flag held while worn, or {'flag': str, 'pulses': int} for a timed one. 'stunned' must be timed.

params.name: affects
params.doc: Affects every instance carries, built with item_affect(...).

params.name: variants
params.doc: Related item prototypes by free-form name, for transform.

params.name: charges
params.doc: Uses before the item is spent, at least 1; None for unlimited.

params.name: empty
params.doc: After the last charge: 'destroy', 'keep', or the name of one of the item's variants.

params.name: use_effect
params.doc: Effect primitive that use applies, with the user as caster.

params.name: use_target
params.doc: Whom use_effect acts on: 'enemy', 'ally', 'self', 'item' or 'none'.

params.name: use_lag
params.doc: Recovery lag in pulses after a use; at least 0.

params.name: modifiers
params.doc: Rules modifiers active while the item is worn.

params.name: procs
params.doc: Combat procs that fire during auto-attack swings.

params.name: version
params.doc: Prototype schema version for persisted state migration.

declarations.name: loot
declarations.doc: A loot roll, for mob(loot=[...]). chance is a percent from 0 to 100.

params.name: label
params.doc: Item prototype label dropped on death.

params.name: chance
params.doc: Drop chance in percent, 0 to 100.

params.name: count
params.doc: Number of items dropped when the roll succeeds.

params.name: id
params.doc: The mob's declaration name within the package.

params.name: name
params.doc: Display name shown to players.

params.name: keywords
params.doc: Words players can use to target this mob.

params.name: desc
params.doc: Description shown when looking at the mob.

params.name: level
params.doc: Mob level.

params.name: stats
params.doc: Base stats the mob starts from, built with stats(...).

params.name: vitals
params.doc: Maximum vitals the mob starts from, built with vitals(...).

params.name: resists
params.doc: Damage resistance percentage by damage type, built with resists(...).

params.name: skills
params.doc: Known skills mapping skill label to proficiency (0..100).

params.name: senses
params.doc: Base sense score by channel, merged over sight and sound at 1; 0 senses nothing on that channel.

params.name: memory_pulses
params.doc: Combat memory window in pulses, overriding module(memory_pulses); 0 keeps none, None uses the world's.

params.name: think
params.doc: Custom AI function fn(ctx) run on each think cycle.

params.name: think_every
params.doc: Pulses between AI think cycles.

params.name: leash
params.doc: Most exits from its home room the mob's own movement goes; None for no leash.

params.name: hooks
params.doc: Custom hooks, by name, run with ctx.call_hook.

params.name: behaviors
params.doc: Built-in behaviors such as wander(...) or aggressive(...).

params.name: dormant_recovery
params.doc: How the mob recovers when its room wakes from dormancy.

params.name: loot
params.doc: Loot rules rolled when the mob dies, built with loot(...).

params.name: traits
params.doc: Traits defined by the world's plugins.

params.name: factions
params.doc: Faction labels the mob belongs to; when absent, its own prototype label.

params.name: version
params.doc: Prototype schema version for persisted state migration.

declarations.name: package
declarations.doc: Declares the package. Must be called exactly once, in package.star.

params.name: api_version
params.doc: The script API version this package targets.

params.name: kind
params.doc: Package kind: 'zone', 'lib', 'rules' or 'skills'.

params.name: title
params.doc: Human-readable title of the package.

params.name: reset_world_ticks
params.doc: World ticks (30 s each) between zone resets, or None for no periodic reset.

params.name: shared_namespaces
params.doc: Attribute namespaces this privileged (lib or rules) package may write across packages.

params.name: modifiers
params.doc: Zone-wide rules modifiers by modifier point name.

params.name: expected_tombstones
params.doc: Prototype labels intentionally removed in this version, for migration checks.

params.name: migrate_noop
params.doc: Prototype labels whose version rose without needing a migrate() function.

params.name: id
params.doc: The room's declaration name within the package.

params.name: name
params.doc: Display name shown to players.

params.name: desc
params.doc: Room description shown when looking.

params.name: size
params.doc: Track size: 'cramped' (1 slot), 'normal' (3 slots) or 'large' (6 slots).

params.name: regions
params.doc: Region tags that apply their modifiers in this room.

params.name: tags
params.doc: Tags for plugin restrictions and scripts.

params.name: flags
params.doc: Room flags such as 'always_active' or 'dead_end_ok'.

params.name: exits
params.doc: Exits leading out of this room, built with exit(...).

params.name: spawns
params.doc: Mob spawn rules for this room, built with spawn(...).

params.name: commands
params.doc: Room-local commands mapping verb name to fn(ctx).

params.name: hooks
params.doc: Custom hooks, by name, run with ctx.call_hook.

params.name: modifiers
params.doc: Room rules modifiers by modifier point name.

params.name: version
params.doc: Prototype schema version for persisted state migration.

params.name: id
params.doc: The skill's declaration name within the package.

params.name: kind
params.doc: Skill category, such as 'spell' or 'skill'.

params.name: cost
params.doc: Vitals spent on cast, built with vitals(...).

params.name: warmup
params.doc: Pulses of casting warmup before the skill resolves.

params.name: lag
params.doc: Recovery wait-state pulses after the skill resolves.

params.name: range
params.doc: Maximum target range.

params.name: target
params.doc: Kind of target the skill accepts.

params.name: channels
params.doc: Channels required and emitted when casting.

params.name: interrupt
params.doc: Warmup interruption rules ('damage_pct', 'stun').

params.name: attack_while_casting
params.doc: True if auto-attacks continue during warmup.

params.name: effect
params.doc: Declarative effect primitive applied when the skill resolves.

params.name: resolve
params.doc: Custom function fn(ctx) run when the skill resolves.

params.name: tags
params.doc: Tags for plugin restrictions and scripts.

params.name: unrecognized
params.doc: Lines for players who don't recognize the skill: begin, room, victim, resisted_room, resisted_victim, noun.

params.name: label
params.doc: Mob prototype label to spawn.

params.name: count
params.doc: Maximum number of instances maintained by this rule.

params.name: respawn_pulses
params.doc: Pulses before a slain mob respawns.

params.name: at_index
params.doc: Track index in the room where the mob spawns.

effects.name: apply_affect
effects.doc: Attach a timed buff or debuff.

params.name: name
params.doc: Affect name; applying the same name again replaces the existing affect.

params.name: duration
params.doc: Duration in pulses; None makes an item affect permanent.

params.name: stat_deltas
params.doc: Stat adjustments while the affect lasts, built with stats(...).

params.name: flags
params.doc: Flags the affect grants, such as 'no_regen'.

params.name: tick_every
params.doc: Pulses between on_tick calls, or None for no ticking.

params.name: on_tick
params.doc: Top-level function fn(ctx) called every tick_every pulses.

params.name: on_expire
params.doc: Top-level function fn(ctx) called when the affect expires or is removed.

params.name: expire_msg
params.doc: Text sent to the target when the affect ends.

params.name: modifiers
params.doc: Rules modifiers active while the affect lasts, by modifier point name.

params.name: sense_deltas
params.doc: Sense score changes by channel while the affect lasts.

params.name: max_vital_deltas
params.doc: Vital maximum adjustments while the affect lasts, built with vitals(...).

params.name: resist_deltas
params.doc: Damage resistance adjustments while the affect lasts, built with resists(...).

params.name: applies
params.doc: Item affects only: 'worn' or 'carried'.

params.name: procs
params.doc: Combat procs that fire during auto-attack swings.

params.name: add_tags
params.doc: Tags a room gains while the affect lasts; a room affect only.

params.name: remove_tags
params.doc: Tags a room loses while the affect lasts; a room affect only.

params.name: dice
params.doc: Damage dice such as '2d6+1'.

params.name: type
params.doc: A declared damage type, such as DAMAGE.fire; the unarmed type if omitted.

effects.name: dispel
effects.doc: Remove the target's affects that match every given criterion. Affects flagged 'intrinsic' are never removed.

params.name: name
params.doc: Affect name to remove; a trailing * matches every name with that prefix.

params.name: flag
params.doc: A flag, or a list of flags; matches affects carrying any of them.

params.name: all
params.doc: True to match every affect.

params.name: count
params.doc: Most affects to remove, oldest first, or None to remove every match.

effects.name: heal
effects.doc: Restore a vital, up to its maximum.

params.name: dice
params.doc: Amount restored, as dice such as '2d4'.

params.name: vital
params.doc: The declared vital to restore.

effects.name: knockback
effects.doc: Push the target along the track.

params.name: steps
params.doc: Track positions to push the target, at least 1.

effects.name: pull
effects.doc: Draw the target along the track.

params.name: steps
params.doc: Track positions to draw the target, at least 1.

params.name: effects
params.doc: Effects applied in order.

params.name: pulses
params.doc: Pulses the target is stunned, at least 1.

params.name: label
params.doc: Mob prototype label to spawn.

params.name: count
params.doc: Number of mobs to spawn, at least 1.

params.name: duration
params.doc: Pulses before the summoned mobs vanish, or None to keep them.

behaviors.name: aggressive
behaviors.doc: Behavior: attacks matching actors it notices. toward is 'players', 'mobs', 'all' or label patterns.

params.name: toward
params.doc: Who to attack: 'players', 'mobs', 'all', or label patterns such as 'goblin_*'.

params.name: unless_level_above
params.doc: Spare actors above this level, or None to attack any level.

params.name: unless_level_below
params.doc: Spare actors below this level, or None to attack any level.

params.name: chance
params.doc: Percent chance of looking for a target on each think, 0 to 100.

params.name: disposition_below
params.doc: Attack only targets whose disposition is strictly below this threshold (-100..100).

params.name: prefer
params.doc: Plain data passed to the world's target_order; None chooses as described.

params.name: priority
params.doc: Proposal priority; higher wins. None uses the behavior's default.

behaviors.name: assist
behaviors.doc: Behavior: joins fights alongside allies, given as label patterns such as 'goblin_*'.

params.name: allies
params.doc: Allies to help, as label patterns such as 'goblin_*'.

params.name: disposition_above
params.doc: Help allies and spare opponents whose disposition is strictly above this threshold (-100..100).

params.name: prefer
params.doc: Plain data passed to the world's target_order; None chooses as described.

params.name: priority
params.doc: Proposal priority; higher wins. None uses the behavior's default.

behaviors.name: defend
behaviors.doc: Behavior: attacks whatever its owner is fighting; with group, whatever the owner's in-room group members are fighting.

params.name: group
params.doc: Also defend the owner's in-room group members.

params.name: priority
params.doc: Proposal priority; higher wins. None uses the behavior's default.

behaviors.name: flee
behaviors.doc: Behavior: flees when any listed vital is at or below its percentage of its maximum.

params.name: below
params.doc: Percentages (0..100) by vital, built with vitals(...).

params.name: priority
params.doc: Proposal priority; higher wins. None uses the behavior's default.

behaviors.name: follow
behaviors.doc: Behavior: follows the first matching actor it meets ('players', 'mobs' or label patterns).

params.name: target
params.doc: Who to follow: 'players', 'mobs', or label patterns.

params.name: disposition_above
params.doc: Follow only leaders whose disposition is strictly above this threshold (-100..100).

params.name: priority
params.doc: Proposal priority; higher wins. None uses the behavior's default.

behaviors.name: guard
behaviors.doc: Behavior: denies an exit to everyone who isn't an ally (default: other mobs) while the guard is present.

params.name: exit
params.doc: Direction of the exit to guard.

params.name: allies
params.doc: Who may pass: 'players', 'mobs', 'all', or label patterns.

params.name: disposition_above
params.doc: Actors whose disposition is strictly above this threshold (-100..100) are allowed through.

behaviors.name: heel
behaviors.doc: Behavior: follows its owner by the shortest path, however far. Does nothing for a mob without an owner in the world.

params.name: priority
params.doc: Proposal priority; higher wins. None uses the behavior's default.

behaviors.name: pursue
behaviors.doc: Behavior: heads for the nearest matching actor within range exits.

params.name: target
params.doc: Who to pursue: 'players', 'mobs', or label patterns.

params.name: disposition_below
params.doc: Pursue only targets whose disposition is strictly below this threshold (-100..100).

params.name: priority
params.doc: Proposal priority; higher wins. None uses the behavior's default.

params.name: range
params.doc: Exits searched from the mob's room; None searches the whole world.

behaviors.name: retarget
behaviors.doc: Behavior: while engaged, asks target_order whom to fight and switches to its pick if that is not the primary target.

params.name: prefer
params.doc: Plain data passed to the world's target_order; required.

params.name: toward
params.doc: Non-engaged actors in the room to consider: 'players', 'mobs', 'all', or label patterns.

params.name: disposition_below
params.doc: Consider only non-engaged targets whose disposition is strictly below this threshold (-100..100).

params.name: chance
params.doc: Percent chance of asking target_order on each think, 0 to 100.

params.name: priority
params.doc: Proposal priority; higher wins. None uses the behavior's default.

behaviors.name: scavenge
behaviors.doc: Behavior: picks up items lying within reach.

params.name: priority
params.doc: Proposal priority; higher wins. None uses the behavior's default.

behaviors.name: wander
behaviors.doc: Behavior: with a percent chance per think, steps through a random open exit within radius exits of home.

params.name: radius
params.doc: Maximum distance from home, in exits.

params.name: chance
params.doc: Percent chance of taking a step on each think, 0 to 100.

params.name: priority
params.doc: Proposal priority; higher wins. None uses the behavior's default.

constants.name: DAMAGE
constants.doc: A struct of the world's declared damage types, such as DAMAGE.fire; a misspelling fails at that line.

constants.name: DIR
constants.value: struct(north = "north", east = "east", south = "south", west = "west", up = "up", down = "down", northeast = "northeast", northwest = "northwest", southeast = "southeast", southwest = "southwest")
constants.doc: Standard exit directions, such as DIR.north and DIR.west.

constants.name: MODIFIER
constants.value: struct(to_hit = "to_hit", damage = "damage", bonus_damage = "bonus_damage", defend_hit = "defend_hit", receive_damage = "receive_damage", mitigate = "mitigate", initiative = "initiative", cast_allowed = "cast_allowed", move_cost = "move_cost", move_pace = "move_pace", regen = "regen", advance_lag = "advance_lag", retreat_lag = "retreat_lag", retreat_fail_lag = "retreat_fail_lag", flee_fail_lag = "flee_fail_lag", skill_check = "skill_check", skill_power = "skill_power", item_power = "item_power")
constants.doc: Rules modifier points, such as MODIFIER.damage and MODIFIER.to_hit.

constants.name: SEMI_PERMANENT
constants.doc: A duration (in pulses) that effectively never ends; accepted wherever a timed affect takes a duration.

constants.name: SENSE
constants.doc: Perception senses (SENSE.sight, SENSE.sound, declared senses) and SENSE.all.

constants.name: SIZE
constants.doc: Track size constants for rooms: SIZE.cramped, SIZE.normal, SIZE.large.
